summary: The experiment is running on the existing A10. Isolated structured train/eval datasets passed audit and fresh n0.17m training started first. Before any held-out arm result existed, the user amended the protocol to train all five scales unconditionally and rank them only after the full sweep.

deviations.before: Train n8.6m and n16.6m only when smaller candidates miss an absolute quality gate.
deviations.after: Train n0.17m, n1.1m, n3.7m, n8.6m and n16.6m unconditionally; use metrics only for post-hoc comparison and ranking.
deviations.bias_control: The amendment occurred during fresh n0.17m training before any held-out evaluation existed, so no observed scale result selected the new rule.

not_established: Which tokenizer scale is visually acceptable.
Whether any tokenizer candidate can support a controllable dynamics model.
decision: Complete all five tokenizer arms before choosing a candidate, and do not start dynamics until the aligned five-scale grid passes explicit visual review.

revision_history.reason: Preregistered the adaptive tokenizer scale protocol before v2 GPU training.
